in_sanskrit.name: Arv
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Arrow, Direction
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arv एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arvābhūta' meaning 'arrow' or 'direction'. In Hindu mythology, the god Agni, who is the god of fire and the messenger of the gods, holds an arrow in his hands, symbolizing his role in transmitting messages between the divine realm and the human world.
